title: Island Circuit
hook: Race your friends three laps around an island; first over the line wins.
prompt: drive cars around a track for three laps and the first one over the line wins

controls.steer: steer the car left and right

round.winBy: The first car to finish three laps wins; the finish order is shown.

mechanics.as: three laps through the track's gates

rules.summary: Everyone drives a car around a closed track. Pass the gates in order and finish three laps; the first car over the line wins and the finish order is shown.

characters.describe: a small car in your colour

build.how: a module in src/car.js that gives each player a car body (a slot model) in their colour, with its pose sent like any player's
build.accept: each player sees their own car and every friend's car on the track

build.what: steer, speed up and brake with grippy arcade handling
build.how: src/car.js drives the car from the steer, accelerate and brake controls with speed, grip and turn rate from rules.params
build.accept: holding accelerate moves the car forward, steering turns it, and braking slows it to a stop

build.what: a wide closed track with edges that keep cars on it
build.how: a module in src/track.js that lays a closed road loop on the island from rules.params, sets the race gates along it, and pushes cars back from its edges
build.accept: a car driven into the edge stays on the road, and the road leads back to the start line
